readout_1_dispersion.noise_floor_note: the ratio this read-out would show if every match had identical true spread, given the resample count — a pass must clear it

readout_2_signal.note: decided on excess error (realised Brier minus the Brier the prediction implies); the raw correlation is reported only to show the confounding it removes

readout_3_thin_clubs.note: informational — confirms where the effect sits, not a kill criterion

decision: E0 passes: per-match uncertainty varies and predicts excess error. E2 (posterior-variance Kelly) is worth building.
purpose: E0 — does per-match model uncertainty vary enough to be worth staking against? Report-only; promotes nothing.
method: random-weight (Bayesian) bootstrap, mean-1 Exponential(1) row weights, monthly refit, point-in-time folds
